reviews.comment: Very good professor, taught the class very informatively

Lectures weren't always the most interesting, but she is incredibly knowledgeable about numerical analysis and knows how to teach it well. DO NOT slack on this class. I got a 70 on one test and did really well on the rest, but missed like two homeworks and lost out on an A. It's super easy to do well; you just have to be willing to try.
Amazing professor, please take her for honors seminar if given the opportunity. So helpful.

Her teaching style is engaging and easy to follow. Her notes provided at the end of lectures online also also well made! The best part I for this professor is that the exam review is provided with the formula sheet she will be using. Saves time for figuring out what you need to remember for the exams. Practice exams were made well too!!

Lots of extra credit that some other ENGR 102 professors would not offer, it helps a lot to tank for the midterm and final. Very kind and understanding if there is any problems with your group lab for the week. Good lectures and always ready to answer a question. Stick to doing your labs, homework, extra credit, on time. You'll get at the least a B

Dr. Ritchey is an amazing teacher and an even better person. She is so caring, and is really understanding when you have to miss class or make anything up. She explains concepts really well and is great at engaging the classroom even at 8:00 am

This class is not easy by an means, but Ritchey makes it enjoyable. So much so, that I came back for more to PT for her class. She is frankly a very caring and down-to-earth professor, and the best 102 prof you could get. Her lectures are beneficial for learning the material, she gives generous extra credit, and a curve at the end of the semester.
She is absolutely awesome. 10/10. Exams are super hard, so do the extra credit.

Dr. Ritchey was amazing, her lectures are engaging and she is always willing to help you out. The class itself isn't too difficult, but the exams are pretty brutal so make sure to go over all of the provided study materials before them.  If you have a choice, take Dr. Ritchey!

Ritchey is an excellent professor for a difficult class for those who have no prior experience with it. Group labs which helps a lot with learning, quizzes once a week over the previous lecture, and she will do anything she can to help you. I honestly wish she was a super genius and could've taught all of my other classes this semester. Loved her!

Great prof very good at teaching python. I had previous experience programming but not with python. Group assignments are pretty easy and clear. A quiz every week that are super easy. Do make sure to study for Exams because they aren't easy. I failed my last one but because of all the extra credit available still got an A.

I love you prof ritcheyyyyy. She is so amazing and down to earth. Honestly we learned a lot becuase the class is very go with the flow however you feel type. She is amazing for advice and honestly taught so much about campus life and culture as well as different POVs. Her classes fill up quick becuase shes great, its a sign...
Amazing class. I struggled a lot in her class, but she was willing to help me and work with her students. She is the type of professor that I want in every class.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ritchey is so nice. Attendance isn't mandatory, but there are quizzes every week. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT. You are so chilling if you do them. Tests are kind of hard but if you actually try to learn and do the labs you will be fine. Also don't let other people in your group carry you or else you will be cooked for exams.
she is the goat

Very nice professor. As someone who already knew how to code, this class was free, but if you don't have experience, you need to put in the time and effort to learn to do python well. Knowing the syntax is not the same as knowing how to write actual code! She is very nice, loved her lectures.

My favorite professor this semester by far. I really enjoyed going to her class. While Engineering 102 is a hard class no matter what, this professor will help you as much as possible. She's accessible outside class and is extremely lenient on missed quizzes. Her class is also pretty interesting and fun. Definitely take her.

I've never coded before. This class was a coding class. It was difficult, but Dr. Ritchey provided more than enough materials to work on to improve coding skills. She's a great professor and is very forgiving and understanding.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is honestly an amazing professor probably one of the few I have this year. Easy to talk to, smart, and not only she gives clear guidance and good lectures in class but outside of it she is also helpful in guiding you with whatever else you may need whether its a coding question or simply a career decision that you would like to take.

The class is challenging, but the professor makes it fun and engaging. Work closely with your team during labs, since collaboration helps a lot. Don't hesitate to ask questions—clearing up confusion early makes the material easier to understand.

Engr102 sucks in general if you don't have python experience, but Ritchey made the class engaging and as easy as she could. There is 2 tests and they both suck, but she gives 2 extra credit assignments to help your grade. She is really nice and is there to help with questions. Just do good on the quizzes and labs and the class is easy to get a B in

Dr. Ritchey is an amazing prof. She made learning Python simple and easy to digest. Her lectures are fun, and she's always there to answer your questions. Just be ready to do some work outside of class for weekly (solo and group) coding projects, but those aren't too hard as long as you pay attention. Her slideshows are always available on Canvas.
Dr. Ritchey has been so accommodating and kind towards all students. Highly recommend her.

216 sucks, but that's on a class level, not a professor level. For what it's worth, Dr. Ritchey made the lecture portion of the class bearable, and with a little more effort than average you could probably wrangle an A from this class, especially with Ritchey as your professor.
Didn't learn anything in class. I only passed because of the lab reports.

Loved her lectures, and is an awesome prof who cares about her students, and very accessible outside of class. The only thing is that she does not curve the final like other profs, nor does she curve final grades. Had 89.3 and know others with similar points who were not curved. Final matters a lot.

Ritchey is an amazing professor - the gold standard. Her lectures are clear and engaging. There is quite a bit of homework that has a lot of coding. Exams are on paper and no coding. She provides her code which is very helpful for HW. Would highly recommend - learned a lot!

Ritchey was just really awesome. My TA's made the labs free 100s so the only thing to actually worry about was the final (which everyone always says sucks). But the final was easy either because Ritchey is just that good at teaching and providing resources or no one actually studies for it. I studied for a week and got a mid A on the final.

AMAZING PROF! She best prepares you with engaging lectures and plenty of practice problems. Final is crazy hard and you have to actually study for it. Try your best on labs and quizzes to get a buffer for the final. She makes it very easy to get good grades on homework and quizzes. She is a great lecturer and I would take her again!!

90% of the grade is split between 4 tests, the other 10% is weekly homework. She is an amazing professor that cares a lot about the students. There are formula sheets on all of the exams, but take studying seriously. I bombed the one exam I didnt take seriously and it killed my grade. Some of the work might be tedious but the worst isnt on the exam

DR. RITCHEY IS THE BEST! Exams were 90% of our grade and based on her notes(she posts them) and practice exams. Homework(10%) was python assignments and some work-by-hand problems. If you go to class and take notes, it's a smooth sail. Ask questions! Ritchey breaks complex problems down as if you're a kindergartner.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: DR. RITCHEY IS THE BEST! Exams were 90% of our grade and based on her notes(she posts them) and practice exams. Homework(10%) was python assignments and some work-by-hand problems. If you go to class, pay attention, and take notes, it's a smooth sail. Ask questions! Ritchey breaks complex problems down as if you're a kindergartner.

Dr. Ritchey was great, especially for how poorly designed of a class 216 was. It ranges from basic statistics to rotational physics, but Ritchey's lectures are very thorough, so don't miss them. The final will be hard so make sure to study for it.

Dr. Ritchey is an amazing professor especially if you have never coded before. She explains all the concepts well and is accessible during office hours outside of class. Overall Dr. Ritchey's class was very straight forward the only reason I got a B was because of the second exam.
Dr Ritchey was excellent in teaching first years with ENG102. She taught very clearly. Would definitely recommend to anyone starting with engineering.

Technically you don't need prior programming experience for 102, but without it be prepared to put in the work. I managed an A- with Ritchey without any, so it's 100% doable. Make sure to do the extra credit she offers, and start on labs early. Get help from Ritchey if you need - copying won't help you in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Ritchey is a kind professor who is knowledgeable about what she teaches. There's two exams, both of which are difficult but doable if you put in the work. Quizzes are generally straight-forward, but don't blow them off because they make up a huge part of your grade. Also do the extra credit - you will need it, and it's good practice.
She was astounding. Helped me so much this semester and was so kind all the time. Please take her! She is the GOAT!!

Ritchey's amazing. She genuinely cares about her students and is so passionate and excited about what she teachers. She's always super kind and patient whenever you ask her questions or for help, by far the best 102 prof.
She is good and the PTs are really helpful
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very positive and uplifting toward her students. If you need help, ask and you shall receive. She goes through slides but elaborates and provides plenty of examples. She records lectures for if you are sick or need to rehear something missed in lecture. Sometimes the slides are long, but she does her best to stay engaging. Terrific teacher!!

Dr. Ritchey is absolute GOAT for ENGR102, Sse is so nice. The way she formats her slides makes it long, but it really isn't bad. She gives time to study before quizzes and her exams are very similar to the quizzes in terms of questions. The textbook assignments are technically optional, but she gives so much extra credit if you do them.

Very good prof! She was very enthusiastic about her lectures, and sometimes she would go over time. She always let people leave if they needed to, however. Posts current videos of lectures. Homeworks are hard but work with friends. She'll always help you in office hours as well. Always ask questions- she is approachable and WILL help you every time
Ritchey does everything she can to help you prepare for the final that every freshman engineer dreads. If you put in the work, you truly won't need to be concerned.

Dr. Ritchey is such a fun and respectable professor. She is awesome at explaining concepts and works to properly prepare her students for exams and quizzes with plenty of practice material. She was always energetic and clearly shows a passion for teaching. Take her if you can!

Ritchey is a very kind professor, and goes out of her way to help you succeed. Unfortunately, I didn't really jive with her lecture style, which I particularly found hard to pay attention to, but it seems others may disagree.

I would say she is a good professor, but perhaps not my personal favorite.

If you get this professor, props to you because she makes life so easy. If you have questions, she's always available. Most of the homework is easy, but it does get harder in the second half of the semester. For the midterm, she literally gave us a chance to make up, twice. For the final, she gave us lifesaver candies during the exam. Easy A.

Very helpful during officer hours and cares about her students. The Final Exam is perhaps the roughest part of the course but she prepares you well for and offers plenty of practice problems. She does not grade or handle the labs, but she knows how to provide assistance if you ever need help with the labs. 10/10, would definitely take her again.

Dr. Ritchey is a great professor that cares about your success. She is very available throughout the week to help you with any questions you have. This class has weekly homework that can be tedious, but it is doable. She is the best professor for ENGR/PHYS 216; try to take her if you can.

Dr. Ritchey is amazing at lectures, and utilizes the ZACH lecture rooms very well. However, her quizzes and exams are quite hard, and she straight up told me that she makes the first few quizzes nearly impossible to get an 'A' on to encourage students to do the extra credit. You HAVE to study for the exams - they pull questions from the ZyBooks.

Dr. Ritchey is an amazing professor. While this class may be difficult for those who haven't coded before, she explains the material in an easy-to-digest way. Her classes always score the highest on the exams, so if you choose a professor, Dr. Ritchey is an amazing choice. Her office hours are easily accessible and she is helpful if you visit them.

Ritchey is a great prof. Her lectures are very straight forward and do great at simplifying coding, which made it very easy to learn. 102 has a lot of group and individual homework but she was always sure to adjust due dates when needed and made sure we were all on track. I am taking her next semester for 206, highly recommend!

Dr. Ritchey's lectures were very good and she was very funny. Coding, at least for me, is a lot of trial and error, so when there is a test with written coding problems, you are not able to use trial and error. This makes the tests very hard to do super well on.

She does an incredible job at making sure youre able to understand the content. All her lectures are personalized to her style so she is able to add her own stories and stuff. Homework might be a bit more than other classes, but it good for learning the content and prepares you well for the tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Attend lectures or else you will get lost. Unlike other profs, you can check ur answer for HW if they are correct. Try to get as many 100s as possible in ur labs and HW cause u need them since the EXAM IS EXTREMELY HARD & there's NO CURVE (same exam for the profs too).
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
This class was very easy but the exam was impossible. Dr. Ritchey is very caring and puts lots of effort into her lectures. The homework isn't hard as long as you don't procrastinate. 
Unrelated, but it looked like only a quarter of the class went to lectures after the third week. (lectures are once a week - 50mins)

Dr.Ritchey is definitely a sweet and caring lady who is easy to talk to and understanding of all students. The only reason I gave a 4 is the class she teaches is not very rigorous besides the final so her lectures are kind of surface level and not super detailed but in a way they do not need to be. Overall great prof and would take again!

Dr. Ritchey it definitely one of the best professors I've had at A&M. Dr. Ritchey is just a great person who is very kind and truly cares. The final is definitely the hardest test I have taken to date, but if you just study and do well enough in the class before then it is easy to get an A.

I love prof Ritchey! After 1st few lectures a lot of people stopped attending, but she's so nice and I felt bad doing that for her. Her homework can be quite difficult, but she is super helpful in her office hours and on her discord. Quizzes every week, super easy take home quizzes. Teaches valuable info and wants the best for her students.

Dr. Ritchey is by far the best professor I have had at A&M so far. Her dedication to the success of her students is unmatched, and she is very personable and approachable. She also offers much help outside of class and truly cares about teaching her students. I genuinely looked forward to attending her lectures. Bottom Line: Take Dr. Ritchey!
Dr Ritchey was a great professor and was very engaging! She knows what she is talking about and is very prepared for every class. Take this class with her if you can!
Amazing lecturer and helped me understand some topics that would have been really difficult otherwise. Homework could be pretty difficult at times.

Ritchey has entertaining, high-quality lectures and is easily accessible outside class, but the homework and quiz assignments are poorly written (although very easy), typically requiring unintuitively oversimplified assumptions and the usage of a convoluted homework format that made homework assignments ridiculously tedious for little to no reason.
Ritchey is a very kind teacher and solid lecturer. The homework is super easy, as is the content of the class. You don't even have to go to lecture if you don't want, but I would recommend it.

Ritchey is funny, caring, and good at explaining programming, reading the online textbook is optional but doing all of questions in it will give you extra credit and a quiz drop. Like all ENGR 102 classes, there's individual and group assignments for coding and if u have questions, she's willing to help.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Ritchey is very knowledgeable and approachable for questions. She also makes most of the quiz/exam material used across the engr 102 classes, so she is a good prof to take. Lots of homework and the exams were rough, but DO THE EXTRA CREDIT FROM THE BEGINNING. You will need it. I also highly recommend going to PT office hours. An A is doable.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Ritchey was one of my favorite professors this semester. Her lectures are very easy to understand with quizzes once a week over what you learned the previous class. About 1 hour of lecture a week and the other 3 hours are for you to work on team projects. Forgiving with late assignments and very helpful to ask questions. Highly Recommend

Dr. Ritchey is the best ENGR102 professor. She is extremely chill in class and is well-respected. Even if you have Python experience, attend her lectures - they are concise, informative, and never take more than 50 minutes. Every week there is a quiz over what was lectured, a team lab, and several individual labs. She offers extra credit as well.

Ritchey was a fantastic prof, she did the absolute best considering what the class is. Available out of class and has the easiest hmwk, loved her. Majority of your grade is from the labs, and how you do it completely depends on your TA's. The final was my only complaint, the average was in the 40s with no curve so it completely ruined grades.

Fantastic teacher. Quizzes are super easy. One homework assignment a week. Ritchey's office hours are great if you need help on the homework, or check with a friend. Homework isn't too hard though. Final exam is tough, average is probably around high 40s(all teachers give the same exam). She only curves based on your lab grades, not the final exam.

Had her for 102 and 216 and I truly believe she's the best prof for both. 216 was only one lecture per week, but even then, she teaches everything you need to know. She didn't post the final exam averages but claims her students always do good, and I believe it. Homeworks can get long, but the most important thing: STUDY FOR THE FINAL.

Ritchey is the best ENGR 102 professor hands down. Her lectures are extremely informative and she assigns way less work than other professors. All the homework was very doable. The exams (especially the final) were a little difficult, however, if you put in the work an A is definitely achievable. No prior coding knowedge/practice is required.

She let me make up a week 3 quiz on the last day of class. She is super kind and lenient and has a small workload, compared to the other 102 Profs. She also does not require attendance so I was able to leave classes once I finished my labs.

ENGR 102 was very hard for me because I had not had any coding experience before, so some of the weekly assignments took me upwards of 15 hours to do and I had to ask for a lot of help. The lectures explain things fairly well, but you have to code something yourself in order to learn.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: ENGR 102 is literally just python, so if you don't know how to code maybe try to learn some basics before the class haha. Ritchey explains everything really well, but once you get towards the end of the class things start to get a lot harder (especially if you've never taken a comp sci class before). The class is team & individual labs, & 2 exams.

This class was my first big experience with coding and Dr Ritchey made it much less frightening. She's one of the sweetest instructors I've ever met, and while the quizzes and labs can be very difficult, she's willing to drop a million hints to help put you on the right path. My advice, ALWAYS try for the extra credit assignments, you'll need them.

Best ENGR professor. Does not require zybooks that other professors require. Does lots of examples while lecturing that other professors don't do. Gave us 41 bonus points bc we scored 41 against Alabama. Only grades are the 2 labs per week, weekly quizzes, and the midterm/final. Probably gives the least work out of all ENGR professors.
Ritchey is very nice and wants you to succeed. Her lectures are helpful and she will give you everything you need to do well in the class. Definitely recommend.

MY FAVORITE PROF EVER! Dr. Ritchey is an amazing prof and always makes her self super accessible outside of class. There is quite a bit of work for the class so be prepared, but it is manageable as long as you start early. Also she makes her own hw and uses the textbook as extra credit, so textbook is optional(at least it was in Fall 2020).
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: She was great! Taught everything with passion and made sure we all understood. Her homeworks were pretty challenging but she said she does this to better prepare you for the final. Labs were a huge pain and will make you hate your life but theyre the same no matter who you have. Overall shes a great choice. I wish I took her for 102.

Her lectures are amazing. She has flexible hours outside of class. Responds fast to emails. She genuinely cares about her students and lectures are actually fun because she brings in cool real world connections. I really loved her class.

Dr. Ritchey is so sweet I absolutely love her. In lecture, always willing to explain topics again in depth and her office hours were also really helpful as she was always patient and would really help on hard homework questions. The labs are the hardest part so ask TA's for help and he final was alright since she prepared our class really well! GL
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved Prof Ritchey's class, she was an angel and her lectures were made well, she explained everything with ease. There was a module quiz every week & homework due every 2 weeks, with labs being due every 2 weeks as well. The most difficult thing was the labs, which took a lot of time. Overrall, Dr. Ritchey the sweetest and amazing!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Ritchey is one of my favorite profs! I had her for ENGR 102 and really enjoyed her both semesters. This class is very difficult, but Ritchey is incredibly approachable, friendly, and super helpful and knowledgeable about the concepts she teaches. She clearly cares a lot about her students!
Very nice and wants her students to do well. Helped boost grades with extra credit. Not much else to say.

Dr. Ritchey is such a sweet and caring professor who is passionate about engineering. The majority of your grade in this class will be labs, so that is mostly dependent on your TA's, but if you put in the work you should be fine. Dr. Ritchey truly cares about her students and her lectures are interesting and well-organized. She's awesome!

Dr. Ritchey is an incredibly kind, funny, caring and overall chilled out prof. Her lectures are very interesting and she is very clear about what you need to know for the homework and the final exam. Since the TA's do all the grading, your grades will vary based off of how harsh the TA's are but Dr. Ritchey is fair and will compensate for this.
Super caring prof

Dr. Ritchey is hands down the best professor I have taken so far. I looked forward to her class each week, she is super sweet and loves to interact with the class during lectures. Her lectures are super fun and she makes the material interesting. She is very helpful in office hours and gives great feedback on homeworks and labs if you ask for it.

Dr. Ritchey is nicest prof I've had. She is super friendly and easy to talk to. She will help you understand concepts you don't quite understand and will tell you if your homework answers are right so you can get full credit. As long as you stay ahead in this class, it should be a fairly easy A

Mrs. Ritchey is an incredible professor. She's really passionate about teaching and she's a REALLY nice person. Take her if you get the chance, she makes ENGR102 and ENGR216 a lot easier; however, with that in mind, there are still quite a few assignments and modules, but everything's relatively simple. GL HF

Ritchey is by far the best professor I've had. She is the sweetest person ever and she works so hard to make sure her students are succeeding. She is always available to answer any questions you have. I highly recommend scheduling one-on-ones with her; she is beyond empathetic and wants you to learn and do well. 100000% would take her again.

I only got a B because my group that was assigned was terrible and got me into a lot of tough situations when it came to the labs. She was a decent professor and can help you if you start your assignments early.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: There are many labs. If you pay attention in class and play around with the coding concepts to actually learn what each is and how to implement them then the class is very easy. I enjoyed her lectures they were fun and made sense. She is very accessible via email so if you are stuck on a lab ASK! Start working on the labs early. Good class!

Dr. Ritchey's really teaches coding fundamentals well, and her class is manageable even in the pandemic. She provides so many opportunities for extra credit for assignments that you shouldn't feel like you have to do everything perfectly. The tests are hard and thorough. She gives lots of work, so you should try extra hard not to procrastinate.
Best professor for ENGR 102!! She's extremely helpful and understanding, and she cares a lot about making the class the best for her students.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: Good professor that is available outside of class for you to ask questions. Sometimes the lectures do not help with the assignments at all, but if you go to her lab time or office hours she will help you.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Very understanding and helpful. Ask questions and used office hours, she could help me fully understand lab or homework questions.

Good professor that knows what shes talking about. Sometimes can be hard to understand because she doesn't always dumb-down her lectures. Very nice and easy to get help. Most homework problems are incredibly difficult but can be found on chegg. Took during covid so didn't have to take final. Very nice lady that wants you to learn content & succeed.

Decent professor, not a very difficult class. Hope you get put into a good group because the labs are a huge portion of your grade. Labs are confusing but aren't graded too harshly, and the lecture side of the class is easy. Class is pretty much the same for every professor, but some are easier or harder. I would say she is in the middle.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: DR. Ritchey is extremely helpful and understanding, and I highly recommend taking her class.

Prof Ritchey is a really good professor. She actually cares about her students and teaches the course material in a way that is easy to grasp. There is homework but if you do them then they are good practice for the test. My only regret is that I wasn't able to take her for ENGR 216.

Dr. Ritchey was a very kind professor and you could tell she cared about her students. However, her lectures went very quickly and were hard to understand sometimes (she did have a short period of time to present them which I understand). There was a class activity portion every class so make sure to attend class. You will have a random TA for lab.

Dr. Ritchey is the best professor to take for ENGR 216 and ENGR 217. I'm finishing up her 216 course now and will take her next Fall for 217. She does not badger you with tough grading on homework. Her TAs are usually good graders and are not too strict. The lectures are very informative and the professor stays after class to explain concepts.

Dr. Ritchey is very good at dealing with students who need help outside of class. She does a great job of explaning material and communicating to students in a cheerful, concise way. If you put in the mandatory work and don't skip labs or lectures your grade will be much happier than the alternative.

Dr. Ritchey is definitely one of the best engineering professors I've had. She tries to make the lectures easy to understand and the final is optional. She answers emails and is accessible outside of class. Make sure to go to class since she has quizzes at the end of lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lectures were straightforward and didn't take too much time. I had prior programming experience so the class itself was more or less a breeze. Would recommend if you either way since she doesn't hold those that know how to code back and genuinely helps those who have little to no experience. Would watch out for the tests but other than that 5/5.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: ENGR 102 is awful if you are not good at coding or become frustrated with it like I did many times. Dr. Ritchey is very caring and available outside of the classroom and her office hours are a great option if you are struggling. The tests are very hard, but she is probably the best option for 102. (Make sure to do good on weekly quizzes and labs)
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Shes probably the best engr 102 professor you can get. Shes cares a lot about her students success and gives extra credit. Also, her quizzes are a lot easier than most professors.

Dr. Ritchey was one of my favorite teachers that I had this past year. She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Do not be afraid to ask her questions, she truly wants you to learn. I came into her class with no coding experience and I did not feel like I was behind. You have to come to class but it's pretty engaging!

Compared to the other ENGR 102 teachers, I think she is a solid option. She does have homework every week, and some weeks it is very difficult, but it is doable. All the tests are ridiculously hard, so study for the quizes. No complains for Mrs. Ritchey.

Mrs. Ritchey is an awesome professor. She is very clear and concise in regards to teaching the python language. Even though there is a fair amount of homework and labs you have to do, that is generally just ENGR102 in general. She likes to talk about football and is overall just a great teacher. Would def take again!
A very nice teacher. I enjoyed going to her class due to her easy lectures. I'd definitely recommend her for ENGR 102.

Dr. Ritchey is a pretty cool person. She mostly just read the lectures off of the power points, and she has lots of enthusiasm in her voice when she speaks. She's also really into Aggie culture. I suggest you take her if you're into that stuff.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Ritchey is definitely one of the best profs you can have. She is very nice and helpful towards everyone. She makes sure to lecture and review stuff needed to do well on the test/quizzes. She gives an assignment every class, but plenty of time to complete them. She provides extra credit as well. Try getting her if you can!
